import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static long b, c, g, n, q, r, t, u, x, y, z;
    static TreeMap<Double, TreeSet<Ratio>> result = new TreeMap<>();

    static class Ratio implements Comparable<Ratio> {
        long numerator, denominator;

        Ratio(long numerator, long denominator) {
            this.numerator = numerator;
            this.denominator = denominator;
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(Ratio o) {
            if (this.numerator * o.denominator < o.numerator * this.denominator)
                return -1;
            if (this.numerator * o.denominator > o.numerator * this.denominator)
                return 1;
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        x = sc.nextLong();
        y = sc.nextLong();
        n = sc.nextLong();

        g = gcd(x, y);
        x /= g;
        y /= g;
        q = x / y;
        r = (int)(x % y);

        // Helper function equivalent
        class SaveRatio {
            void save_ratio(long a) {
                g = gcd(a, b);
                result.computeIfAbsent(Math.abs(u - a * z) / (double) t, k -> new TreeSet<>())
                      .add(new Ratio(b / g, a / g));
            }
        }

        SaveRatio saver = new SaveRatio();

        for (b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
            g = gcd(y, b);
            c = b / g;
            z = y / g;
            t = b * z;
            u = q * t + r * c;
            saver.save_ratio(u / z);

            if (u % z != 0) {
                saver.save_ratio((u + z - 1) / z);
            }
        }

        Map.Entry<Double, TreeSet<Ratio>> p = result.firstEntry();
        Ratio pRatio = p.getValue().first();

        System.out.println(pRatio.denominator + "/" + pRatio.numerator);
    }

    static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            long temp = b;
            b = a % b;
            a = temp;
        }
        return a;
    }
}
